entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It appears as though we will need to move[n]about in the same manner as before.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: To think we'd end up flying through space...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The awe I felt at seeing that flying bank[n]feels like a distant memory at this point.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Some airlocks are working, but others[n]aren't?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I hope we can reach our goal with just[n]the ones that are on...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hmm... We need to get past here,[n]though...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Guess we can't just sit around.[n]Let's keep going.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It looks like this is the end. We did it,[n]you guys!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That was simple! Let's keep blazing a path[n]through here!
